reviewer_notes: Prominent mature sacred fig (Ficus religiosa) overhanging southern walkway. Clear visual scale from vehicle height clearance (~4.0m) and pavement width. Historical photo does not prove 2026 survival; bounds accepted for sensitivity testing only.
Mature Syzygium cumini on south sidewalk directly adjacent to 5.6m dashcam waypoint. Dense canopy. Uncalibrated dashcam optics require wide bounds (+-2.0m height, +-1.5m crown).
Semi-mature Syzygium cumini positioned between T08 and T09. Crown moderately dense. Scaled against adjacent 2-story commercial facade.
Saraca asoca planted in sidewalk pit. Upright dense crown. Scaled against adjacent retail shopfront entry height (~3.0m).
Companion Saraca asoca on south sidewalk at 7.5m capture distance. Compact columnar foliage. Accepted with +-1.5m height uncertainty.
Tecoma stans (Yellow bells) small ornamental tree/shrub growing in raised roadside planter. Smallest crown in core cohort. Bounds span 3.8m to 6.5m height.
